entities.name: Malach of the Anvil
entities.description: Vulshok warrior and Warchief of the Anvil tribe on Mirrodin who was corrupted and Phyrexianized.

entities.name: Koth of the Hammer
entities.description: Malach's friend who found his weapon.

entities.name: Farris of the Anvil
entities.description: Malach's clanmate who killed Phyrexianized Malach.

events.summary: Malach scouts ogre territory and disappears.
events.quote: Malach embarked on a scouting mission into ogre territory and disappeared

events.summary: Malach, corrupted by the Glistening Oil, betrays his people and kills the rebel Darven.
events.quote: betrayed his people, killing the rebel Darven

events.summary: Koth finds Malach's weapon abandoned deep in Phyrexian territory.
events.quote: later found Malach's weapon, lying abandoned deep in Phyrexian territory

events.summary: Farris wakes to find a Phyrexianized Malach dragging him.
events.quote: Malach encountered Farris of the Anvil after a battle

events.summary: Farris attacks and kills Phyrexianized Malach, whose eyes seem to thank him.
events.quote: As the Phyrexianized Malach died, his eyes seemed to thank Farris
